_generated.note: ROM 脚本编译出的场景片段：say/setFlag/battle 由回放事件生成，选择御三家、训练家队伍、地图放置和触发器不在编译范围内。

steps.speaker: Bianca
lines:
OK, I'll take this Pokémon!
Cheren, that one's yours!

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines:
Hey, how come you get to pick
out my Pokémon?

Oh, never mind. I wanted {rival}
from the start, anyway.

steps.speaker: Bianca
lines:
Everyone has chosen a Pokémon!
...So that's that!

Hey, I know!
Let's have a Pokémon battle!

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines: Honestly, Bianca...

Even though they're still weak Pokémon,
you shouldn't have Pokémon battles
inside a house.

steps.speaker: Bianca
lines:
Don't be a worrywart!
These little ones are weak, like you said.

We have to let them battle so they'll get
stronger. It's settled, {name}!
Get ready for a Pokémon battle!

steps.speaker: Bianca
lines: Wow...

{name}, you're gonna be
an awesome Trainer someday, I can tell!
No doubt!

steps.speaker: Bianca
lines: Wha...?

I got so absorbed in having my Pokémon
use moves, I won before even realizing...

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines: Bianca, would you take a look around?

steps.speaker: Bianca
lines:
Wh-whoa!
What happened?!

Wow! Pokémon are amaaaaazing!!
So little, but so strong!
I'm so glad that I get to have a Pokémon!

...Oh.
Um, sorry about your room, {name}.

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines: You...are completely hopeless.

Here!
I'll restore your Pokémon for you.

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines:
It's amazing that you won
without your Pokémon's losing any
energy, which is called HP.

But you used some of the moves'
Power Points, or PP, though.

{name}'s Pokémon needs
to be fixed up, too.

steps.speaker: Bianca
lines:
Hey, Cheren!
How about you battle, too?

With all you know, I'm sure you can
battle without turning the room into
a disaster area like I did!

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines: I believe you're right!

It'll be no problem for me to keep
the room from getting any messier.

Besides, it's not fair if you two are the
only ones who get to have fun battling!

It's decided. You'll be my opponent...
in our first Pokémon battle!
Let's see what you can do, {rival}!

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines:
I made a strange blunder
in my first battle, but
this feeling I have...
...I'm finally a Trainer.

But first, we'd better go apologize to
your mother about this messed-up room.

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines:
This feeling...
Finally, I'm a Trainer.

On top of that, we'd better go apologize
to your mother about this room.

steps.speaker: Bianca
lines:
Oh!
I'd better come, too!

rom_prologue_mom.label: 妈妈（区域 390 · npc 0 · 已选御三家）

steps.speaker: Mom
lines:
Phew! I'm taking a little break
from cleaning up.

You and your Pokémon should take
a break, too.

Good Trainers don't push their
Pokémon too hard.

You and your Pokémon should all be
filled with energy again!
Now, you can go anywhere!

Hi there!
I've been waiting for you young people!

Let me introduce myself again.
My name is...

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines:
Professor Juniper?
We know your name.

steps.speaker: Professor Juniper
lines:
Come, come, Cheren!
This is not a time to take things lightly.

Today is a day to remember always, so
it's best to behave with some formality.

That being so, once again, my name is
Professor Juniper, and I am researching
when and how the creatures called
Pokémon came into existence.

Oh, that's unusual!
You've already had a Pokémon battle!
So maybe that's why...

It feels as though your Pokémon have
already begun to trust you!

By the way, would you like to give your
Pokémon a nickname?

steps.speaker: Professor Juniper
lines:
You aren't planning
to use a nickname? Well, that's fine, too.

As for why I gave all
of you Pokémon...

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines: It's for the Pokédex, right?

steps.speaker: Bianca
lines: Pokédex?

steps.speaker: Professor Juniper
lines:
I am astonished.
Nice work, Cheren!

You have already studied Pokémon
extensively, haven't you?

Still, let me explain everything from the
beginning, for everyone's sake.

The Pokédex is a high-tech device that
automatically records the Pokémon
you encounter!

So, I want you three to visit many
places and meet all of the Pokémon
in the Unova region!
This is my request.

{name}!
Cheren! Bianca!

You'll go on an adventure to
complete the Pokédex, will you not?

steps.speaker: Bianca
lines: OK!
I mean... Yes, professor!

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines: Thank you very much.

Because of you, I can become a Pokémon
Trainer, exactly as I've always wished.

steps.speaker: Professor Juniper
lines: All of you, thanks!

You have given me the best
possible answer!

steps.speaker: Professor Juniper
lines:
Next, I need to teach
you how to meet Pokémon.
Please meet me at Route 1, OK?

steps.speaker: Bianca
lines:
S-since the professor asked us,
it's OK to go on an adventure, right?

I can explore and maybe find out what
I want to do in life. I think I'd like that.

steps.speaker: Cheren
lines: Of course.

We can travel however we want
while we complete the Pokédex.
